ns2:course.label: Tap Dance II
ns2:course.description: Intermediate level of tap dance technique for non-dance majors. Course is a continuation of DANC 120, emphasizing a progression in movement vocabulary, style, rhythm, and performance quality. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: DANC 120 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: DANC 120 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Dance or Dance major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Written assignments and concert attendance is required.
